title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.4.0.3748
body_markdown:
* Enable Copilot Chat private beta for accepted users.
* Chat can be used to generate code or answer questions related to your code.
* You can reference any file from your project. The open editor and recently opened files are referenced automatically.
* To save time, you can use `/` commands to perform tasks like:
  + generate tests
  + simplify code
  + fix problems
  + explain code
  + generate documentation
* Chat can be used by opening the GitHub Copilot Chat tool window, hitting the `Ctrl+Shift+C` shortcut or directly via the Copilot context menu in your editor.
